scenes.stage_direction: The household's polished public account meets the records retained by its workers. Amara speaks for herself.

dialogues.speaker: Amara
dialogues.text: No. My silence is not a fee for finding my baby.

dialogues.speaker: David
dialogues.text: You don't have to surrender the evidence.

dialogues.speaker: Amara
dialogues.text: The younger employee heard me refuse. Now she wants to speak privately.

metadata.evidence_summary: She rejects the bargain without surrendering her evidence.
